# Fixture A-6

`astronaut.jpg`: public portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, NASA.
512 × 512, converted to JPEG quality 85 (53 177 bytes); these are not pixels
captured by the system, and no inference images are stored.

- Exact origin: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png>
- Provenance and public domain: <https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut>
- NASA original: <https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn>

The scikit-image documentation declares the photo public domain, with no
known copyright restrictions. The conversion only reduces its size.
